events.text: Goal: GNN-based floorplanning on the FloorSet-Lite benchmark. Beat the simulated-annealing baseline on HPWL by at least 5% with zero overlap violations.
exp-031: SA baseline on FloorSet-Lite (100 designs): normalized HPWL 1.000, overlap violations 0/100, runtime 41 min.
exp-034: GraphSAGE encoder + RL placer: HPWL 0.970 (-3.0%), overlap violations in 12/100 designs, runtime 6 min. 3 of 5 seeds diverged during training.

Decision: drop the RL placer, switch to supervised placement + a Tetris-style legalization pass. Reason: RL training unstable (3/5 seeds diverged) and overlaps. Tradeoff: needs SA solutions as labels.
exp-041: GAT encoder + supervised placer + legalizer: HPWL 0.955 (-4.5%), overlap 0/100, runtime 9 min, peak GPU memory 22 GB.
Decision: revert the encoder from GAT back to GraphSAGE. GAT gave no HPWL gain over GraphSAGE and doubles GPU memory.
exp-043: GraphSAGE + supervised placer + legalizer: HPWL 0.952 (-4.8%), overlap 0/100, runtime 8 min, peak GPU memory 11 GB.

Open question: is the 5% target against SA at its 41-min budget or at equal runtime? Investigating whether net-weight edge features help. Next: run the ablation without the legalizer to measure how much HPWL it costs.
